about: The Start-a-game GPT's bank, its hand-written part (docs/PLAN-start-a-game-gpt.md step G1): requests typed on a show's page, each with the stand-in bot's answer (`answer`: the raw text, or a JSON object sent as the bot would) and what our check makes of it (`expect`). They cover what an ideal draft can't: the bot's mistakes (a number nobody said, a moment the show doesn't have, a value that doesn't go with the rest, chatter and broken JSON) and the paths around a game (another show, two games, not a game). The rest of the bank is the capability tracker's requests (tests/fixtures/engine-capabilities.json), drafted ideally by bank.js idealDraft: one list of requests, never two. `page.couch` and `page.pool` size the couch and who can be drafted where the case needs them. Read by tests/game-words.test.js and scripts/dev-test/check-game-words.js. `expect`: state (game | ask | cantYet | none), spec (the checked spec, exactly), asks (the parts asked, in any order), cantYet (how many), newMoments (how many), dropped (the parts dropped), fixed (the parts our check changed), offers (the offers' keys).
